input.description: Recurring tier: a PREPAID CALL BALANCE. One x402 payment of $1.00 credits 1,000 units of prepaid capacity (= $0.0010 per call), drawn down across sessions on the cheap deterministic routes (<= $0.01). The funded balance is the source of truth, queryable at GET /v1/subscription/balance, and remaining_calls is reported on every paid response. Non-auto-renewing: a one-time top-up whose spend stops at zero. No account, no API key, no monthly lock-in.

network.description: Optional x402 network id (defaults to eip155:8453).

payer.description: Optional self-asserted wallet (0x<40-hex>) used when no payment header is presented.
